title: Wood Elf XxX Heroes and Lords submods 1.0.0
author: Dwjliel
description:
A collection for the woodelfs, nudifying some modded Lords and Heroes and rebalancing (nerfing) them.

Also an option for Branchwraiths as a separate download from my (upcoming) Asrai compilation.

Trajann's Katalin, The Wild Huntress <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2959914930>

Naru the Huntress <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3242912296>

The Moonlight Twins - Legenday Heroes for Wood Elves <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3566095272>

**All the submods offered on this page require being subbed to the Steam original**

Katalin has just had minor nerfs to her melee.

Naru is a sniping debuffer who grows into an infantry blender.

The Twins have changed a LOT, as they were massively, hugely, OP. They also come with a 3rd waystalker hero, who I nerfed a bit, but then stopped, as u get a decision to reject him anyway. The Blonde is a kitbashed model inspired by the original mods Porthole and Unit cards. The other one is totally replaced by a kill la kill mod I found and wanted to use with jiggly boobs!

If u just want the skins for each mod, not stats, open in RFPM and delete the folders that are not variantmeshes.

Branchwraith mod features a couple of varied looks for each type of branchwraith, including one for the Athel Loren Spell-lore <https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3560344083> mod. Note the BEAST maloveant branchwraith is untouched deliberately for lore reasons.

Portholes and unit cards are the ones provided by original mod, if it offered none, AI was used.

Here's my > Cathay Collection Version <https://www.loverslab.com/files/file/49648-sexy-cathay-heroes-sub-mod-collection-taoyan/> < of this mod.
